name: B&G Foods
outlook:
What B&G Foods says to expect

  • Fiscal 2026: net sales, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPSB&G Foods increased its net sales guidance for fiscal 2026 to a range of $1.760 billion to $1.800 billion, increased its adjusted EBITDA guidance to a range of $280.0 million to $290.0 million, and reaffirmed its adjusted diluted earnings per share at a range of $0.575 to $0.675.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 10, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
